blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Akbayan party-list Rep. Chel Diokno has clarified that the prosecution panel believes in the evidence it has presented and will present for Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial, whether or not the Senate Impeachment Court lowers the number of votes needed for a conviction. In his speech on Wednesday, during oral arguments on how many votes are needed to convict an impeached official when several members are absent, Diokno said he and the other members of the prosecution panel are confident in the case they have presented before the impeachment court. “The prosecution is confident in its case.
